source_text:
Question (verbatim wording, Markdown emphasis omitted):
I recommend accepting Onelink’s current bundled funding options, subject to GBP compatibility, while requiring another decision for future additions or non-GBP settlement. Do you agree?
User reply (verbatim): Agree. As well make sure customer see available time slots when choosing Delivery/Pickup time instead of always clicking on 'Check' as it's difficult for them to guess what exactly slots are free!

approved.time_selection: show available delivery/pickup slots automatically; no repeated guess-and-Check

history: continued master; independent continued reviewer requested separately
readback: Design contracts and canonical source update only. Preserve all17methods, GBP scope, chef delivery feasibility and no per-slot cap. Automatic visible slot discovery; server revalidates selection. No visual/app/provider/Trello mutation.
